If it’s positive, there are two real roots; if zero, one real root; if negative, complex roots. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a) to find the solutions.

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f’(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. These x-values are candidates for maxima or minima.
